# Marine Cookers — Techimpex

> Techimpex (Marine Cookers) designs and manufactures cookers, ovens, hobs, grills and coffee makers for sailing and motor yachts. Founded in Conegliano (Treviso), Italy, in 1974. Clients include leading shipyards (Ferretti, Sunseeker, Sanlorenzo, Cantiere del Pardo) and private owners. The site is available in English, Italian, French, German and Spanish.

## Products
- [Product overview](https://www.techimpex.tv/products): full range of marine cooking equipment.
- Categories: gas cookers, gas cookers with oven, electric cookers, electric cookers with oven, built-in gas ovens, built-in gas cooktops, built-in electric cooktops, electric grills, coffee makers, spare parts, panholders.
